'''Petre Constantin Buchwald''' ({{langx|hu|Buchwald Péter Szilárd}}; 21 May 1937 – 16 December 2022) was a Romanian politician. A member of the [[Democratic Alliance of Hungarians in Romania]], he served in the [[Senate of Romania|Senate]] from 1992 to 1996.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.cdep.ro/pls/parlam/structura2015.mp?idm=9&leg=1992&cam=1|title=BUCHWALD Petre Constantin|work=Chamber of Deputies|language=Romanian}}</ref>

Buchwald died on 16 December 2022, at the age of 85.<ref>{{cite news |last=Gál|first=László|date=17 December 2022|title=Elhunyt Buchwald Péter, a Kolozsvár Társaság korábbi elnöke, az RMDSZ egykori szenátora|trans-title= |url=https://transtelex.ro/kozelet/2022/12/17/elhunyt-buchwald-peter-a-kolozsvar-tarsasag-korabbi-elnoke-az-rmdsz-egykori-szenatora|language=Hungarian|work=Transtelex|location= |access-date=18 December 2022}}</ref>
